description: Superposition of the AlphaFold UMAD1 UMA domain onto the MVB12A subunit of the 6VME ESCRT-I headpiece, with a random-window null and a steric clash test against TSG101, VPS37B and VPS28
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict

# ================= BLOSUM62 + affine Needleman-Wunsch (biopython unavailable) ==========
AAS="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
rawm="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
Mx=np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()] for r in rawm.strip().split("\n")])
B62={(AAS[i],AAS[j]):int(Mx[i,j]) for i in range(20) for j in range(20)}
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); tX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); tY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); tX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); tY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            c=[M[i-1,j-1]+s,X[i-1,j-1]+s,Y[i-1,j-1]+s]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); M[i,j]=c[k]; tM[i,j]=k
            c=[M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); X[i,j]=c[k]; tX[i,j]=[0,1][k]
            c=[M[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Y[i,j]=c[k]; tY[i,j]=[0,2][k]
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0:
            a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append(s2[j-1]); st=tM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1:
            a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append("-"); st=tX[i,j]; i-=1
        else:
            a1.append("-"); a2.append(s2[j-1]); st=tY[i,j]; j-=1
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return "".join(a1[::-1]),"".join(a2[::-1])

def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])

# ================= 6VME: experimental ESCRT-I headpiece ==========
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE".split(),
             "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVM"))
txt=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6VME.pdb",timeout=180).text
ATM=[]
for l in txt.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and l[17:20].strip() in t2o and l[16] in (" ","A") and l[76:78].strip()!="H":
        ATM.append((l[21],int(l[22:26]),l[12:16].strip(),t2o[l[17:20].strip()],
                    float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
prot={}
for c in "BFGHIJ": prot[c]="TSG101"
for c in "CKLMNO": prot[c]="VPS37B"
for c in "ADPQRT": prot[c]="MVB12A"
for c in "EUVWXY": prot[c]="VPS28"

bych=defaultdict(list)
for a in ATM: bych[a[0]].append(a)
xyz={c:np.array([[a[4],a[5],a[6]] for a in v]) for c,v in bych.items()}

# which chains form the copy around MVB12A chain A
partners=[]
for c in bych:
    if c=="A" or c not in prot: continue
    d=np.linalg.norm(xyz["A"][:,None,:]-xyz[c][None,:,:],axis=2)
    if (d<5.0).sum()>0: partners.append((c,prot[c],int((d<4.5).sum())))
print("chains contacting MVB12A chain A (heavy-atom pairs < 4.5 A):")
for c,p,n in sorted(partners,key=lambda z:-z[2]): print(f"   chain {c} = {p:7s} {n:5d} pairs")
PART=[c for c,p,n in partners if n>0]

# MVB12A chain A: CA coords per residue
mvbCA={a[1]:np.array(a[4:7]) for a in bych["A"] if a[2]=="CA"}
mvbSEQ={a[1]:a[3] for a in bych["A"] if a[2]=="CA"}
resA=sorted(mvbCA)
print(f"\nMVB12A modelled in 6VME chain A: {resA[0]}-{resA[-1]}  "
      f"seq={''.join(mvbSEQ[r] for r in resA)}")

# contact residues of MVB12A (to any partner chain in this copy)
partxyz=np.vstack([xyz[c] for c in PART])
contact={}
for r in resA:
    ra=np.array([[a[4],a[5],a[6]] for a in bych["A"] if a[1]==r])
    d=np.linalg.norm(ra[:,None,:]-partxyz[None,:,:],axis=2)
    contact[r]=int((d<4.5).sum())
CONT=[r for r in resA if contact[r]>0]
print("contact residues (MVB12A numbering):",CONT)

# ================= AlphaFold UMAD1 monomer ==========
j=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/C9J7I0",timeout=180).json()[0]
print("\nAlphaFold model:",j["pdbUrl"].split("/")[-1])
afpdb=requests.get(j["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
AF=[]
for l in afpdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[76:78].strip()!="H":
        AF.append((int(l[22:26]),l[12:16].strip(),t2o[l[17:20].strip()],
                   float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66])))
umCA={a[0]:np.array(a[3:6]) for a in AF if a[1]=="CA"}
plddt={a[0]:a[6] for a in AF if a[1]=="CA"}

# ================= map MVB12A residues -> UMAD1 residues ==========
mv=fa("Q96EY5"); um=fa("C9J7I0")
A1,A2=nw(mv[195:273],um[65:137])            # MVB12A 196-273 vs UMAD1 66-137
i,k=195,65; MAP={}
for x,y in zip(A1,A2):
    if x!="-": i+=1
    if y!="-": k+=1
    if x!="-" and y!="-": MAP[i]=k
pairs=[(r,MAP[r]) for r in CONT if r in MAP]
print("\nMVB12A -> UMAD1 mapping over the contact face")
for r,u in pairs:
    print(f"   MVB12A {mvbSEQ[r]}{r:4d}  ->  UMAD1 {um[u-1]}{u:4d}   "
          f"contacts={contact[r]:3d}  pLDDT={plddt.get(u,float('nan')):.1f}")

# ================= Kabsch superposition on the contact-face CA pairs ==========
P=np.array([mvbCA[r] for r,u in pairs if u in umCA])      # target (experimental)
Q=np.array([umCA[u]  for r,u in pairs if u in umCA])      # mobile (AlphaFold)
def kabsch(Q,P):
    qc,pc=Q.mean(0),P.mean(0)
    H=(Q-qc).T@(P-pc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R,pc-R@qc
R,t=kabsch(Q,P)
fit=(R@Q.T).T+t
rmsd=float(np.sqrt(((fit-P)**2).sum(1).mean()))
print(f"\nKabsch superposition on {len(P)} contact-face CA pairs: RMSD = {rmsd:.2f} A")

# null: same number of CA pairs taken from a random unrelated stretch of the model
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); nulls=[]
allres=sorted(umCA)
for _ in range(500):
    s=rng.integers(0,len(allres)-len(P))
    Qr=np.array([umCA[allres[s+z]] for z in range(len(P))])
    Rr,tr=kabsch(Qr,P); fr=(Rr@Qr.T).T+tr
    nulls.append(np.sqrt(((fr-P)**2).sum(1).mean()))
nulls=np.array(nulls)
print(f"null (500 random equal-length CA windows of the same model): "
      f"RMSD {nulls.mean():.2f} +/- {nulls.std():.2f}, min {nulls.min():.2f}, "
      f"empirical p = {(nulls<=rmsd).mean():.3f}")

# ================= steric test: place the whole UMAD1 UMA domain in the ESCRT-I site ==========
UMA=[a for a in AF if 86<=a[0]<=134]
Uxyz=np.array([[a[3],a[4],a[5]] for a in UMA])
Ufit=(R@Uxyz.T).T+t
d=np.linalg.norm(Ufit[:,None,:]-partxyz[None,:,:],axis=2)
clash=int((d<2.2).sum()); close=int((d<4.0).sum())
clashres=sorted({UMA[i][0] for i in np.where((d<2.2).any(1))[0]})
print(f"\nUMAD1 UMA 86-134 docked by superposition into the 6VME site:")
print(f"   heavy-atom pairs < 4.0 A to TSG101/VPS37B/VPS28: {close}")
print(f"   severe clashes < 2.2 A: {clash}   clashing residues: {clashres}")
mvA=np.array([[a[4],a[5],a[6]] for a in bych['A']])
dm=np.linalg.norm(mvA[:,None,:]-partxyz[None,:,:],axis=2)
print(f"   same counts for the experimental MVB12A chain A: <4.0 A {int((dm<4.0).sum())}, "
      f"<2.2 A {int((dm<2.2).sum())}")
print(f"   mean pLDDT UMAD1 66-85 {np.mean([plddt[r] for r in range(66,86)]):.1f} | "
      f"86-134 {np.mean([plddt[r] for r in range(86,135)]):.1f} | "
      f"whole protein {np.mean(list(plddt.values())):.1f}")

# ================= figure ==========
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,4.4))
ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,1)
rs=sorted(plddt); ax.plot(rs,[plddt[r] for r in rs],color="#333",lw=1.5)
ax.axvspan(86,134,color="orange",alpha=.25,label="UMA domain 86-134")
for r,u in pairs: ax.axvline(u,color="crimson",alpha=.35,lw=1.2)
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=.8)
ax.set_xlabel("UMAD1 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_title("A  Model confidence; red lines = projected contact residues")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,2)
ax.hist(nulls,bins=30,color="#9bb7d4",edgecolor="w")
ax.axvline(rmsd,color="crimson",lw=2.5,label=f"contact-face fit {rmsd:.2f} $\\AA$")
ax.set_xlabel("CA RMSD to MVB12A chain A ($\\AA$)"); ax.set_ylabel("random windows")
ax.set_title("B  Superposition quality vs 500 random windows"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,3)
rr=[r for r,u in pairs]; cc=[contact[r] for r in rr]
lab=[f"{mvbSEQ[r]}{r}\n{um[MAP[r]-1]}{MAP[r]}" for r in rr]
cols=["crimson" if mvbSEQ[r]==um[MAP[r]-1] else "#b0b0b0" for r in rr]
ax.bar(range(len(rr)),cc,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(rr))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=6.5)
ax.set_ylabel("heavy-atom contacts in 6VME")
ax.set_title("C  Contact depth; red = identical in UMAD1")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
